title: Get the location tags for a TikTok account
content_data:
Use this endpoint to retrieve the list of available location tags for a TikTok account. You can include these location tags when you publish a video or photo post, allowing your post to display a location. By adding a location tag, you help local audiences and users searching for that area discover your post. This can also boost your engagement by making your content more relevant to nearby users. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/publish/location/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by TikTok creators.
To obtain an access token, use [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/obtain-a-short-term-access-token/v1.3).| ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |business_id {Required}|string|Application specific unique identifier for the TikTok account.

Pass the value of the `open_id` field returned in the response of [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/obtain-a-short-term-access-token/v1.3) to this field.| |search_query {Required}|string|The query you provide to search for a location that can be added to the TikTok account's posts.

Length limit: 100 characters.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/publish/location/?business_id={{business_id}}&search_query=new' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |-|-|-| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/return-codes-appendix/v1.3).| |message |string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/return-codes-appendix/v1.3).| |request_id|string| The log ID of the request, which uniquely identifies a request.| |data|object|Returned data.| #|locations|object[]|A list of the locations.

You can retrieve a maximum of 20 locations.| ##|location_name|string|The name of the location.| ##|location_id|string|The ID of the location tag.

You can pass this ID, along with the `location_name`, to [/business/video/publish/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/publish-a-public-video-post-to-an-owned-account/v1.3) or [/business/photo/publish/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/publish-a-photo-post-to-an-owned-account/v1.3) to display the associated location on your published post.| ##|location_address|string|The additional information associated with the location.

The content you receive varies and may include, but is not limited to:
  • Country only: `United Kingdom`
  • Region/State + country: `Florida, United States`, `Illinois, United States`
  • City + country: `Cairo, Egypt`
  • Full street address: `300 West 47th Street, New York, New York 10036, USA`
| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "locations": [ { "location_address": "United States", "location_id": "22535865201205278", "location_name": "New York" }, { "location_address": "Prince Edward Island, Canada", "location_id": "22535796524027671", "location_name": "New Zealand" }, { "location_address": "Doğanay, Ordu Cd.
